_comment: Minimal built-in catalog for when the real docs.json cannot be fetched.
Covers only the structural keywords and control flow Skript itself cannot
redefine. Every description and example here was written for this project.
The `patterns` strings are Skript's own syntax — `[local] function <.+>`,
`(wait|halt) [for] %timespan%` and so on — so most of them necessarily
match SkriptLang's GPL-3.0 database byte for byte. That is the language's
grammar rather than creative expression, and there is no way to describe
Skript's syntax without writing Skript's syntax. The database itself is
This is a fallback so a first run with no network is still usable, not a

structures.name: Command
description: Registers a server command. The leading slash is optional. Its body holds entries such as `permission:` and `description:`, plus the `trigger:` section that runs when the command is used.
examples:
command /heal:
	permission: skript.heal
	trigger:
		heal player

structures.name: Function
description: Declares a reusable function. Parameters become local variables inside the body. A return type may be given with `::`, `->` or `returns`. `local` restricts the function to the script that declares it.

structures.name: Event
description: Runs its body whenever the named event happens. The leading `on` is optional, and the event may be filtered with `cancelled`/`uncancelled` or given an explicit priority.

structures.name: Options
description: Declares text substitutions for this script. An option is used as `{@name}` and is pasted in literally before parsing, so it may contain any code at all.

structures.name: Variables
description: Gives variables a starting value the first time the script loads. Existing values are never overwritten.

structures.name: Aliases
description: Defines script-local names for groups of items.
examples:
aliases:
	ores = iron ore, gold ore, diamond ore

structures.name: Using Experimental Feature
description: Opts this script into an experimental Skript feature.

sections.name: Conditional
description: Runs its body only when the condition holds. `else if` and `else` continue the chain.

sections.name: Loop
description: Repeats its body once per value. Inside, `loop-value` is the current item, and `loop-index` its position; typed forms such as `loop-player` also work.
examples:
loop all players:
	send "hi" to loop-player

sections.name: While Loop
description: Repeats its body for as long as the condition holds. `do while` checks the condition after the first run instead of before it.

sections.name: For Each Loop
description: Repeats its body once per value, binding the value to a variable you name. Requires `using for loops`.

sections.name: Delay
description: Pauses the trigger for a period. Anything after the wait runs later, so the event can no longer be cancelled.

effects.name: Return
description: Returns a value from a function and stops it.

effects.name: Continue
description: Skips to the next iteration of the innermost loop.

effects.name: Exit Loop
description: Leaves one or more enclosing loops.

effects.name: Cancel Event
description: Cancels the event being handled, so the server does not carry it out.
